caption: The drawing displays three distinct objects arranged vertically in a row, each with intricately designed handles colored in a golden-yellow hue, transitioning to a metallic gray for the functional ends. The object on the left is a pair of tongs, with two elongated, parallel arms ending in small circular gripping tips, and a decorative, symmetrical handle at the top. The central object appears to be a pair of fire iron pincers with a wide, curved gripping section at the base and the same ornate handle style at the top. The object on the right is a shovel, featuring a flat, rectangular, slightly rounded blade at the bottom and a long, slender shaft culminating in the same gold-toned, detailed handle as the other two implements. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the objects are depicted with fine, precise lines and subtle shading. There is a scale depicted beneath the middle and left objects. The artist’s name, "HANS KORSCH," is written in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Fire Tongs and Shovel
